q: Glasner's theorem on the structure of minimal flows: every minimal equicontinuous flow is (topologically conjugate to) a rotation on a compact abelian group. The group is:
opts: Always ℤ_p for some prime p
The Ellis group of the system, which equals the enveloping semigroup (which is a group for equicontinuous systems)
exp: Minimal equicontinuous flows: the enveloping semigroup (Ellis semigroup) E(X) is a compact abelian group, and the flow is conjugate to left-multiplication on E(X). This group is compact, metrizable when X is metrizable, and encodes all the equicontinuous dynamics.
